rationale: W13 G2-11 fix in the acceptance frame: at phone widths the theme positions #top-bar at top:7.9rem, which lands on the generated subtitle (#header h2::before) in the compact fixture header (W07-A D-1; the native reference page at 320 is clean per the G2-26 AB check, so the collision is frame-specific). The W13 block repositions the bar below the subtitle, grows the header's own box with padding so the page title clears the bar, and keeps the bar labels whole at a slightly smaller size so the bar stays on one row. Before frame ad40e72b (bar over the subtitle) -> after frame ea4d9003 (subtitle fully visible, bar on one row below it, title clear), page.normal narrow-mobile.
